questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor (PFBR) at Kalpakkam:
1. It attained first criticality on 6 April 2026; it is built by BHAVINI and was designed by the Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research.
2. It uses natural uranium fuel with heavy water as moderator and coolant.
3. It is the bridge between India's pressurised heavy water reactors and the third, thorium-based stage of the nuclear programme.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The 500 MWe PFBR uses uranium-plutonium mixed oxide fuel and liquid sodium coolant, so the heavy-water description in statement 2 belongs to the first stage PHWRs. First criticality marks the start of a self-sustained chain reaction, not power generation, which comes later.
questions.s: DAE, PIB and SolarQuarter, 6 Apr 2026
questions.h: Stage 1 PHWR, Stage 2 FBR, Stage 3 Thorium

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Integrated Air Drop Test (IADT-02) conducted by ISRO on 10 April 2026:
1. An Indian Air Force Chinook helicopter lifted a simulated crew module of about 5.7 tonnes to about 3 km and released it over the sea, and ten parachutes of four types deployed in sequence.
2. The first Integrated Air Drop Test (IADT-01) was held on 24 August 2025 at Sriharikota.
3. Module recovery was carried out by the Indian Coast Guard.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The test was supported by the IAF, DRDO and the Indian Navy, which handled module recovery. The 5.7-tonne mass matches the crew module of the first uncrewed Gaganyaan mission (G1), so the test validates the parachute deceleration system before that flight.
questions.s: ISRO and ETV Bharat, 10 Apr 2026

questions.q: NASA's Artemis II mission, which splashed down in the Pacific Ocean on 10 April 2026, is best described as
o: the first crewed landing on the Moon since Apollo 17 in 1972
an uncrewed test flight of the Orion spacecraft that remained in lunar orbit for several months
a joint NASA-ISRO mission to deploy a lunar orbiter near the south pole
a crewed lunar flyby on a free-return trajectory, the first crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17 in 1972
questions.e: Artemis II carried Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen of the Canadian Space Agency on a roughly 10-day flyby using the Space Launch System and Orion. It was not a landing; a crewed lunar landing is planned for 2028. India is a signatory to the Artemis Accords.
questions.s: NASA and Vajiram & Ravi, 10 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the National Quantum Mission:
1. India demonstrated a 1,000-km secure quantum communication network under the Mission in April 2026.
2. The Mission was approved in April 2023 with an outlay of Rs 6,003 crore for 2023-24 to 2030-31 and is run by the Department of Science and Technology.
3. Quantum key distribution relies on classical signals, so any eavesdropping on the encryption keys is undetectable.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Quantum key distribution encodes keys in quantum states, so any attempt to intercept them disturbs the states and reveals the eavesdropper, the opposite of statement 3. This is why quantum networks are considered secure for communication.
questions.s: India Science and Technology Portal and Quantum Computing Report, Apr 2026

questions.q:
Statement-I: In May 2026 a study by ISRO's Physical Research Laboratory using the Dual Frequency Synthetic Aperture Radar on Chandrayaan-2's orbiter reported signatures of possible subsurface ice in doubly shadowed craters near the Moon's south pole.
Statement-II: Permanently shadowed craters near the lunar poles are among the coldest places in the solar system.
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Both statements are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I: craters that never receive sunlight stay cold enough to trap water ice for very long periods, which is why they are the targets of water-ice searches. The strongest signal was in a 1.1 km-wide crater inside Faustini, and DFSAR is an L- and S-band radar.
questions.s: Drishti IAS and India TV, 27 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Chandra's Surface Thermophysical Experiment (ChaSTE) study reported in May 2026:
1. A Physical Research Laboratory study using ChaSTE data found that the top few centimetres of lunar regolith near the south pole have two layers, with an upper highly cohesive, porous layer over denser material.
2. ChaSTE is an instrument meant to measure lunar seismic activity.
3. The data were gathered after the Vikram lander hopped about 50 cm on 2 September 2023, having soft-landed on 23 August 2023.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: ChaSTE is a thermophysical probe that measures temperature and thermal properties of the regolith; lunar seismic activity was measured by a different payload (ILSA). The result was published in The Astrophysical Journal.
questions.s: ISRO and UNI, 18 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Polycystic ovary syndrome was renamed Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome (PMOS) by an announcement of the World Health Organization.
2. Eli Lilly India launched Lormalzi (donanemab), a once-monthly intravenous therapy that targets amyloid plaques in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease, in May 2026.
3. The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation, which authorised the marketing of Lormalzi, functions under the Directorate General of Health Services.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The renaming followed a global consensus process published in The Lancet on 12 May 2026, drawing more than 14,000 survey responses, with a three-year transition and the international guideline expected to adopt the name in 2028. Lormalzi is prescription-only for mild cognitive impairment or mild dementia due to Alzheimer's.
questions.s: AJMC, Patient Care, BioSpectrum and Business Standard, 12-13 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about technology developments in May 2026:
1. The India Meteorological Department launched an AI-enabled block-level monsoon onset forecasting model covering 3,196 blocks, giving probabilistic forecasts up to four weeks ahead.
2. GalaxEye's Mission Drishti is described as the world's first OptoSAR satellite, capturing optical and Synthetic Aperture Radar imagery of the same area simultaneously.
3. Synthetic Aperture Radar imagery is blocked by cloud cover and cannot be captured at night.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: SAR is an active microwave sensor, so it sees through cloud and works at night, while optical imagery gives intuitive visuals; combining both is the OptoSAR concept. The satellite of roughly 190 kg was launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 on 3 May 2026.
questions.s: Business Standard, Drishti IAS and ETV Bharat, 3-11 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about a chemistry result published in the journal Science in May 2026:
1. Researchers at IIT Madras and the Indian Institute of Science synthesised the first stable carbon-free analogue of ferrocene.
2. In the new compound an osmium atom is sandwiched between two flat boron-hydrogen (B5H10) rings.
3. Ferrocene, the classic sandwich compound, has a ruthenium atom between two cyclopentadienyl rings.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Ferrocene is the iron-cyclopentadienyl sandwich compound, discovered about 75 years ago. The new compound replaces carbon rings with boron-hydrogen rings and the iron with osmium, which is why it is called carbon-free.
questions.s: IISc and Vajiram & Ravi, 5 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about disease outbreaks reported in May 2026:
1. Africa CDC announced a new Ebola outbreak in Ituri province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 15 May 2026.
2. Africa CDC is the public-health agency of the World Health Organization, headquartered in Geneva.
3. The WHO reported an outbreak of the Andes strain of hantavirus, the strain known to spread between people, linked to the cruise ship MV Hondius.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Africa CDC is the African Union's public-health agency, headquartered in Addis Ababa, and not part of the WHO. The Andes strain is the only hantavirus known to spread from person to person, which made the cruise-ship cluster notable.
questions.s: EWN, Rural Radio and WFTV, May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Nipah virus case reported from Kerala in June 2026:
1. The case was reported from Ramanattukara in Kozhikode district, with RT-PCR confirmation at the National Institute of Virology, Pune.
2. The natural reservoir of the Nipah virus is rodents of the genus Rattus.
3. Kerala has had recurrent Nipah outbreaks since 2018.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The natural reservoir of Nipah is fruit bats of the genus Pteropus, and it is a zoonotic virus. WHO described this as India's second Nipah notification of 2026, after two linked cases in West Bengal in January, and rated the risk moderate sub-nationally and low regionally and globally.
questions.s: ETV Bharat, All India Radio and WHO, Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the hydrogen production facility inaugurated at Kalpakkam in June 2026:
1. It was inaugurated by the Department of Atomic Energy at the Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research and is described as the world's first facility based on the copper-chlorine thermochemical cycle using nuclear process heat.
2. The copper-chlorine technology was developed by the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre.
3. The facility produces hydrogen by electrolysis of water using nuclear-generated electricity.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The facility draws process heat from the Fast Breeder Test Reactor to drive a thermochemical cycle, a route to low-carbon hydrogen without electrolysis. It was inaugurated with Atomic Energy Commission Chairman Ajit Kumar Mohanty participating.
questions.s: ANS, Drishti IAS and DT Next, 26 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Aarogya Setu 2.0, launched on 29 June 2026:
1. It was launched by the Union Minister of Electronics and Information Technology.
2. It is aligned with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission and offers ABHA creation and an AB PM-JAY wallet.
3. The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission was launched nationwide in September 2021.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: It was launched by Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda as a revamped version of the COVID-era app of April 2020. The same event launched the National Health Claims Exchange, the Ayushman Sarathi WhatsApp chatbot, a Drug Registry and the e-Sushrut Clinic.
questions.s: Angel One, The Hitavada and The Statesman, 29 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Central Armed Police Forces (General Administration) Act, 2026:
1. It covers the CRPF, BSF, CISF, ITBP and SSB.
2. It reserves at least 67 per cent of Inspector General posts and 50 per cent of Additional Director General posts for IPS deputation.
3. It empowers the Centre to frame rules on recruitment and service conditions that prevail over conflicting laws, court judgments or earlier orders.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The reservation is the other way round: 50 per cent of Inspector General posts and at least 67 per cent of Additional Director General posts. The Act followed a May 2025 Supreme Court judgment directing a gradual reduction of IPS deputation up to IG level, and cadre officers have challenged it in the Supreme Court.
questions.s: ETV Bharat, All India Radio and PRS India, Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Mizoram:
1. A peace agreement signed on 14 April 2026 with a faction of the Hmar People's Convention (Democratic) led to Mizoram being declared insurgency-free on 30 April 2026.
2. The earlier insurgency by the Mizo National Front ended with the Mizoram Peace Accord of 1986.
3. Mizoram became a full State in 1972.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Mizoram became a Union Territory in 1972 and attained statehood in 1987 after the 1986 Accord. The Hmar faction was the last active armed group in the State, and 43 of its cadres laid down arms at Sesawng near Aizawl.
questions.s: EastMojo, Vision IAS and WION, 14-30 Apr 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about INS Aridhaman:
1. It was commissioned on 3 April 2026 at Visakhapatnam as India's third nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine, after INS Arihant and INS Arighaat.
2. India's SSBNs are built at Mazagon Dock Limited under Project 75.
3. Nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarines form the sea-based leg of India's nuclear triad.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: India's SSBNs are built at Visakhapatnam under the Advanced Technology Vessel project, whereas Project 75 refers to the Scorpene-class conventional submarines built at Mazagon Dock. The commissioning was kept low-key and confirmed by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh on X.
questions.s: Naval News and ThePrint, 3 Apr 2026

questions.q: Which one of the following statements about the Project 17A (Nilgiri-class) stealth frigates is NOT correct?
o: INS Dunagiri, built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd, was commissioned in June 2026 together with INS Sanshodhak and INS Agray
INS Taragiri, the fourth ship of the class, built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd, was commissioned on 3 April 2026
INS Mahendragiri, the sixth ship of the class, was delivered to the Indian Navy at Mumbai on 1 May 2026
The class has seven ships, four built by Mazagon Dock in Mumbai and three by Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers in Kolkata
questions.e: INS Dunagiri, the fifth ship, was built by Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers, Kolkata, and was commissioned on 21 June 2026 together with the survey vessel INS Sanshodhak and the anti-submarine craft INS Agray. All Project 17A ships were designed by the Navy's Warship Design Bureau.
questions.s: Navalnews, ETV Bharat and Drishti IAS, Apr-Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about defence tests in May 2026:
1. India test-launched the short-range ballistic missile Agni-1 from the Integrated Test Range at Chandipur on 22 May 2026 under the Strategic Forces Command.
2. The Strategic Forces Command is a command of the Indian Air Force.
3. DRDO and the IAF conducted the maiden flight trial of the TARA glide weapon, a range-extension kit that converts unguided bombs into precision-guided munitions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Strategic Forces Command, created in 2003, is a tri-service command that manages India's nuclear arsenal under the Nuclear Command Authority. TARA (Tactical Advanced Range Augmentation) was developed by DRDO's Research Centre Imarat, Hyderabad.
questions.s: ETV Bharat, All India Radio and Deccan Chronicle, 7-22 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about India's defence engagements in May 2026:
1. India hosted PRAGATI 2026, its first multilateral military exercise with friendly foreign nations from South and Southeast Asia, at Umroi, Meghalaya.
2. India and South Korea signed a defence cooperation MoU on cyber defence and defence information-sharing in Seoul during Defence Minister Rajnath Singh's visit.
3. The Core Integration and Flight Testing Centre for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft programme is being built at Puttaparthi in Telangana.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The AMCA centre, whose foundation stone was laid on 15 May 2026 at a cost of about Rs 15,803 crore, is at Puttaparthi in Sri Sathya Sai district of Andhra Pradesh. AMCA is a fifth-generation stealth fighter being developed by the Aeronautical Development Agency under DRDO.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, All India Radio and The Statesman, 15-20 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the High-Level Committee on Demographic Changes constituted by the Ministry of Home Affairs on 26 May 2026:
1. It is chaired by retired Justice Prakash Prabhakar Naolekar.
2. It is to report within one year, and its terms of reference include a system for identifying, detaining and deporting illegal immigrants.
3. It is chaired by the Census Commissioner.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Census Commissioner is only a member; the committee also has a retired IAS officer, a retired IPS officer and an economist, with the Joint Secretary (Foreigners-I) as Member Secretary. It will study the causes and consequences of demographic shifts linked to illegal immigration.
questions.s: ETV Bharat and SCC Online, 26 May 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about DRDO flight tests in June 2026:
1. The air-to-surface anti-radiation missile RudraM-II was flight-tested from a Su-30MKI.
2. Three flight tests on 10-11 June included two ballistic missile defence interceptor tests and the maiden flight of the naval anti-ship missile NASM-MR.
3. An endo-atmospheric interception takes place outside the atmosphere, in the mid-course phase of the missile's flight.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Exo-atmospheric interception (the AD-2 interceptor) takes place outside the atmosphere in the mid-course phase, while endo-atmospheric interception (the AD-1 interceptor) takes place inside the atmosphere in the terminal phase. Anti-radiation missiles home in on enemy radar emissions.
questions.s: Drishti IAS, India TV and Raksha Anirveda, 2-11 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Zojila tunnel, between Baltal in Kashmir and Minamarg in Himachal Pradesh, achieved its final breakthrough on 9 June 2026.
2. The Zojila tunnel is about 13.15 km long, and its commissioning is scheduled for February 2028.
3. Union Home Minister Amit Shah said on 11 June 2026 that the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act, 1958 will be removed from the entire Northeast, barring possibly one or two States, in 2027.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Minamarg lies in Ladakh, so the tunnel gives all-weather connectivity between the Kashmir Valley and Ladakh on National Highway-1, not Himachal Pradesh. Shah said about 80 per cent of the Northeast is already free of AFSPA, which applies in areas notified as 'disturbed areas'.
questions.s: Business Today, All India Radio, India TV and Kashmir Reader, 9-11 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Indian Army in June 2026:
1. The first batch of nine women officers trained at the National Defence Academy was commissioned at the passing-out parade of the Indian Military Academy on 13 June 2026.
2. The Indian Military Academy is located at Khadakwasla, Pune.
3. 'Army Uniforms-2026' approves the bandi jacket as part of formal civil attire and discontinues the term 'Royal'.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Indian Military Academy, established in 1932, is at Dehradun, while the National Defence Academy is at Khadakwasla, Pune. The revised dress manual phases out colonial-era practices and introduces a common uniform numbering scheme across the Army, Navy and Air Force.
questions.s: Deccan Chronicle, Swarajya and Business Today, 13-14 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about defence-sector developments in June 2026:
1. The private sector contributed about half of India's record defence production of Rs 1.78 lakh crore in 2025-26.
2. The Delegation of Financial Powers to DRDO, 2026, released on 29 June 2026, adds dedicated provisions for trial campaigns and tests and evaluation.
3. Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers was conferred Navratna status by an order dated 19 June 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The private sector contributed about 24 per cent (about Rs 42,000 crore), with the remaining roughly 76 per cent from DPSUs and other PSUs. Defence exports touched a record Rs 38,424 crore. Navratna status gives public sector enterprises greater financial and operational autonomy.
questions.s: Business Today, All India Radio and ETV Bharat, 17-29 Jun 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about security and intelligence appointments and operations in June 2026:
1. The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet cleared Mahesh Dixit as Director of the Intelligence Bureau for a two-year tenure, succeeding Tapan Kumar Deka.
2. The Intelligence Bureau functions under the Cabinet Secretariat.
3. The CBI's Operation Chakra-VI targeted 'digital arrest' fraud networks through searches at more than 80 locations in 16 States and UTs.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Intelligence Bureau, India's domestic intelligence agency, functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs; it is RAW that sits under the Cabinet Secretariat. 'Digital arrest' scams involve fraudsters impersonating law enforcement agencies over video calls, and the CBI notes that 'digital arrest' has no legal existence in Indian law.
questions.s: Deccan Herald, ETV Bharat and Free Press Journal, 25 Jun 2026
